text: My office has heard from residents on Glebemount Avenue, between O’Connor Drive and Plains Road, about speeding vehicles in their community. They would like speed humps installed on their street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council : 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Glebemount Avenue, between O’Connor Drive and Plains Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a By-law to alter the roadway to install three speed humps on Glebemount Avenue, between O’Connor Drive and Plains Road, generally as shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (April 2, 2024) from Councillor Brad Bradford.
